dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: You must be Sethos, the successor to the Temple of Silence. Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Yep, yep, yep, that's me. Nefer, right? That's what I heard the others calling you. Judging by your outfit, I'm guessing you come from the desert too?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: That's right. Started off in the desert, went to the rainforest, then went from there to Nod-Krai, where I work as an intel broker.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Huh, well this is interesting. You don't seem to talk about yourself all that much, yet here you are volunteering your life story to me... however abridged.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm looking to make some new friends?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I like making friends, too. I'm easier to talk to than Cyno, and a little more streetwise than Tighnari.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Which is why you came over this way, giving me the chance to strike up a conversation with you.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hahaha, was I that obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I think you did fine. You were mindful of my attitude, and hoped to lure me in through sentiment.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: "Lure you in" isn't exactly how I'd put it... I see it more as an invitation.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: An invitation to what?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: To put down your luggage. Lay down your burdens. To return to your homeland, and be truly welcome in the place you once felt so estranged from.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: You're a more interesting heir to Bamoun than I was expecting.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Since you're familiar with my grandfather, I'll assume you're aware of our situation. I'd like to make friends with you, and I think you'd be a great asset to us.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Not to mention the power you and I both hold originally belonged to the same organization.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Aha, there we go. Now we're getting somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And what's your prize student doing?

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: What else would he be doing? Whatever yours is, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And Collei's with them, I suppose. Heh, these kids are rarely apart, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Our elders always said that your school days stay with you forever. This goes doubly so for Sumeru, where "school days" can be long indeed, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Well, does it look like I'm immune, saddled as I am with you and Zaha Hadi?

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Oh, what's that? Tired of us already? And speaking of Zaha Hadi, she mentioned out of the blue how you'd doodle on your books while studying.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Pfft, that's hardly all I used to do while hitting the books.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: She said that you once circled the name of the murderer in a detective novel, and that — just in case someone missed it — you even wrote, "the murderer is so-and-so" as a hint. On the title page, no less!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Did I now? Haha! I suppose I always was the creative type!

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Oh, laugh it up, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Young Cyrus really was a budding genius, wasn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: Full of wild ideas, more like. And you're still very much that kid, you know. A living example of how your school days stick with you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: As they have with you, you straight-laced prig.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* You know what? Let's leave it at that. Might as well bear with one another rather than expect us to "turn our lives around" or something.

dialogues.speaker: Naphis
dialogues.text: ...Truth be told, you should probably keep an eye on Cyno and his friends. We'll all need to tread more carefully than we used to.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I will. Take care of yourself as well, alright? Don't let the pressure get to you.

dialogues.speaker: Qanafiya
dialogues.text: This evacuation was a huge operation. They needed a few people to stay behind and tie up loose ends, and I ended up being one of them. You're lucky you ran into us in time.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I certainly am. *sigh* I don't know how this happened. One thing led to another, and look how it ended up... I just hope our client doesn't get spooked and cancel their order.

dialogues.speaker: Qanafiya
dialogues.text: Fingers crossed. But either way, life goes on, and we all have to make a living somehow...
